title: YouTube Ad Auto-Skipper
desc: Auto-skip/close YouTube ads in a loop via CDP a11y. Detects skip button, overlay close, and ad-showing DOM class. Reloads on unskippable ads.
steps:
Run: powershell -File test/youtube-ad-skipper.ps1 [-Url <yt-url>] [-RunMinutes <N>] [-PollSeconds <N>]
ROOT CAUSE for JS-click failure: YouTube checks event.isTrusted on the skip button; element.click() and CDP-dispatched mouse events both fail. Only OS-level UIA InvokePattern is treated as trusted. Use wkappbot a11y invoke (which calls IUIAutomationInvokePattern.Invoke under the hood).
Skip button UIA grap: {proc:'chrome',cdp:PORT,domain:'www.youtube.com'}#*skip-button*  (matches AutomationId 'skip-button:<N>'; do NOT use '*Skip Ad*' -- that string is not present in the UIA tree)
Detection: lightweight eval-js polling reads classList + offsetHeight (no DOM mutation, no isTrusted concern). State JSON: {ad,skip,overlay}.
Action: when ad+skip are both visible, run 'wkappbot a11y invoke <grap>#*skip-button* --timeout 8 --force'. Success = '[STATE CHANGE DETECTED]' or 'REMOVED' line in output (the 'skip-ad' Group disappears from UIA tree).
Overlay close: '#*overlay-close*' wildcard for ytp-ad-overlay-close-button.
Timeout discipline: keep --timeout >= 8s. The original 3s default was too tight on cold UIA tree; original suggest report ('LAUNCHER timeout 3s') was a timeout issue, not a path issue.
Fixed 2026-05-21: switched from JS .click() (blocked by isTrusted) to UIA invoke (trusted). Verified on Rick Astley video with mid-roll ad: invoke caused state change + adShowing flipped false.
Added 'ending' detection (video in last 2s) + preemptive mute before next ad fires (2026-05-21)

UNIFIED AD DETECTION: var isAd = document.documentElement.classList.contains('ad-showing') || !!document.querySelector('.ytp-ad-player-overlay-layout'); covers both mid-roll (ad-showing) and end-roll (overlay-layout). Reload strategy: location.href = '?v='+vid+'&t='+(currentTime+0.1)+'&end='+(dur-0.1)+'&_clipped=1'

COMPLETE STRATEGY (2026-05-23): (1) End-roll detected (ytp-ad-player-overlay-layout) -> reload t=dur-1 end=dur-0.1 + pauseVideo() -- no ad, paused state. (2) Mid/pre-roll (ad-showing) -> reload currentTime+0.1s -- jumps past ad cue point. (3) Premium banner -> invoke #dismiss-button. (4) Clip playback (clip= param) -> skip all processing. (5) Infinite end-roll loop prevention: &end=dur-0.1 is the key param.

KEY FINDING (2026-05-23): mid-roll ads at t=451/1843 showed overlay=true but ad-showing=FALSE. Both detection methods needed: var isAd=document.documentElement.classList.contains('ad-showing')||!!document.querySelector('.ytp-ad-player-overlay-layout'). Skip first via invoke, fallback to reload.
